name: Kasutamaiza - Creation Control
description: High-level Divine-Beast control strategy utilizing Void recursion, Seed of Creation, and contact Fusion into The Great Kasutamaiza.

name: LeSpookie Singles
description: A 50-card Gemini and trick-or-treat counter strategy featuring costumed children who enter as Normal Monsters and awaken with Gemini summon, dancing shadows, and spooky extra deck evolutions.

name: Base of Story (Kas.)
description: The foundational 14-card Set 1 story deck from Duelingbook (deck 20861703), featuring the creation forces of Kasutamaiza, the Spellspires' Fusion arts, and the rift unsealing Mohousha.

name: Kasutamaiza: Genesis & The Mortal Realm
description: Chapter 1 (ELO 1100): The dawn of Kustomazi. Primordial creator forces alongside mortal realm observers before the rift opened.

name: The Forbidden Sect (Rift Turbo)
description: Chapter 2 (ELO 1450): Forbidden experiments unearth the Seed of Creation. A rift is torn via Contact from Beyond, unsealing Mohousha and invoking The Great Kasutamaiza.

name: Night of the LeSpookie (The Haunting)
description: Chapter 3 (ELO 1600): The ancient ghost legend manifested into reality by A Wicked Shadow. Costumed trick-or-treaters awaken their Gemini powers under LeSpookiest Night.

name: The Lantern Ascension (Apex Boss)
description: Apex Boss (ELO 1800+): The dimensional breach peaks. High-tempo Link and Synchro climb with Magnolia Lantern Ascended and A Wicked Shadow.

name: Quiet Void - Formless Potential
description: Chapter 1 Stage 1 AI Deck: The formless quiet void before creation. Defensive stall and void spirit echoes.

name: The Spark of Genesis
description: Chapter 1 Stage 2 AI Deck: The sudden cosmic spark cutting through the void. Nascent flames and burn disruption.

name: Servants of Genesis
description: Chapter 1 Stage 3 AI Deck: Devout servants preparing the sacred altar of creation for the Customizer.

name: Kasutamaiza - Dawn of Planet Kustomazi
description: Chapter 1 Stage 4 Scripted Boss Deck: Kasutamaiza weaving the celestial seed to spring forth Planet Kustomazi into existence.
